notes:
Top-line: DeepIndex Labs is building a code search and knowledge platform for engineering teams (internal dev portals + customer support coding queries). Heavy emphasis on large embedding corpora (started estimate: 50M - 200M vectors) and nightly re-indexing of code and docs. Current stack: extractor -> Milvus cluster (self-hosted) + light cross-encoder reranker on CPU. Wants lower cost-per-query and sub-200ms end-to-end p99 for developer search queries. Interested in Redwood Private in a VPC, but open to Dedicated for initial ramp. SAML SSO and audit logs mandatory.

Selected quotes from CTO: "We can't tolerate >200ms p99 for dev UX — engineers will notice. Also need predictable unit economics for 10s of thousands of queries/day." 

Key ask: metrics on indexing throughput, recommended sharding for 100M vectors, estimated storage + tokenization cost for embeddings, recommended reranker placement (edge vs central), and fallback model policies for peak traffic.

technical_requirements: Index scale: 50M - 200M dense vectors, average dim=384-1536 depending on model
Freshness: nightly full re-index + incremental hourly updates
Latency: target p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 200ms end-to-end (client->answer)
Throughput: target baseline 5k qps sustained for peak internal CI jobs (burst to 20k)
Cost sensitivity: TCO comparable or better than Milvus + self-hosted GPU reranker
Reranking: hybrid ANN (FAISS/HNSW) + cross-encoder reranker for top-50 candidates
Security: SSO/SAML, per-request audit logs, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency for EU customers
poc_plan: 2-week lab POC: ingest 20M vectors provided by customer, run Redwood Private in customer VPC (small cluster), wire up cross-encoder reranker (open model), measure indexing throughput, CPU/GPU bottlenecks, per-query latency and cost. Deliver: benchmark report, configuration recipe (shard sizes, batch sizes), cost-per-query model, and suggestions for caching/kv-prefix tricks.
notes_short: Enterprise RAG/code-search buyer. Needs nightly reindexing, SAML, sub-200ms p99, 50M-200M vectors. POC scoped.
